name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: A tactile pagination row with 40px controls, a recessed current page, and deterministic press feedback

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Scales the control height, the side padding and the label size together.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the seated underline on the current page. green keeps the themed accent, blue and violet borrow the data colours.

variables.label: Step labels
variables.description: Whether the step buttons read Prev and Next or show single angle marks. The aria labels never change.
